bullets: Completed a 6-month intensive hybrid cloud foundations internship specializing in Amazon Web Services (AWS) infrastructure, compute, and networking.
Built serverless event-driven microservices utilizing AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Amazon S3 storage buckets, and IAM least-privilege security policies.
Applied core networking topologies, CIDR block allocation, and VPC peering configurations aligned with industry standards.
Earned official AWS Academy Graduate accreditation and Credly certification verification in Cloud Foundations.
Specialized in data structures, algorithms, object-oriented software engineering, relational database management (SQL), and web architecture.
Developed internal departmental laboratory management portals and interactive UI tools using zero-runtime static site generation (Eleventy).
Represented the department in collegiate hackathons, winning recognition for responsive UI engineering and accessible frontend components.
Architected 6+ comprehensive static web applications, fluid typography engines, and tactile micro-interaction prototypes with 100% semantic HTML5 and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance.
Developed bespoke micro-interaction systems with spring physics, custom canvas animations, and responsive interactive SVG graphs.
Published open-source web design resources and interactive case studies exploring token pipelines and zero-bloat web development.
